paper_metadata.title: CMOS Oversampling Magnetic-to-Digital Converters
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, two CMOS oversampling delta-sigma TABLE I SOME PUBLISHED INTEGRATED MAGNETIC SENSOR SYSTEMS AND () magnetic-to-digital converters (MDCs) are proposed. The COMMERCIALLY AVAILABLE HALL MAGNETIC FIELD SENSORS first MDC consists of the magnetic operational amplifier (MOP) and a first-order switched-capacitor (SC) modulator. The second one directly uses the MOP to realize a first-order SC modulator. They can convert the external magnetic field into digital form. Both circuits were fabricated in a 0.5m CMOS double-poly double-metal (DPDM) process and operated at a 5-V supply voltage and the nominal sampling rate of 2.5 MHz. The dynamic ranges of these converters are at least 100 mT. The gain errors within 100 mT are less than 3% and the minimum detectable magnetic field can reach as small as 1 mT. The resolutions are 100 T for both of the two MDCs. The measured sensitivities are 1.327 mv/mT and 0.45 mv/mT for the first and the second MDC, respectively.
